item.title: Architecture
item.description:
Baboon follows a clean backend/frontend separation with a well-defined REST API.

High-Level Architecture

┌─────────────────┐ REST API ┌─────────────────┐
│ Frontend (TUI) │ ◄───────────────► │ Backend │
│ Bubble Tea │ │ Game Engine │
└─────────────────┘ └─────────────────┘
 ▲ │
 │ ▼

│ Frontend (Web) │ │ ~/.config/ │

Package Structure

baboon/
├── main.go # Entry point
├── backend/
│ ├── api.go # GameAPI interface & types
│ ├── engine.go # Game logic implementation
│ └── server.go # REST API server
├── frontend/
│ ├── model.go # Bubble Tea model
│ ├── views.go # Rendering
│ ├── styles.go # Lipgloss styles
│ ├── animations.go # Spring animations
│ └── client.go # REST client
├── web/ # React frontend
├── stats/ # Statistics & persistence
├── settings/ # User preferences
├── words/ # Word dictionary

item.title: Feature Overview
item.description:
Baboon is more than just a typing test - it’s a comprehensive typing improvement tool with features designed to help you become a faster, more accurate typist.

Core Features

Beautiful Block Letters

Words are displayed using large Unicode block characters that change colour in real-time as you type:

  • Green for correct keystrokes
  • Red for mistakes
  • Orange highlighting the current position

Real-time WPM Tracking

Watch your speed as you type with a live WPM bar that updates continuously, giving you immediate feedback on your pace.

item.title: How to Play
item.description:
Baboon is designed to be intuitive, but here’s a complete guide to playing.

The Basics

Starting a Round

  1. Launch Baboon: baboon
  2. A word appears in large block letters
  3. The timer starts when you type the first correct letter

Typing Words

  1. Type each letter as you see it

  2. Letters change colour based on correctness:

    • Gray: Pending (not yet typed)
    • Orange: Current position
    • Green: Correct
    • Red: Incorrect

  3. Press Space when you’ve typed the entire word

item.title: Quick Start
item.description:
Get typing in under a minute with this quick start guide!

Terminal Mode

The simplest way to start:

baboon

That’s it! You’ll see a word displayed in large block letters. Start typing!

What You’ll See

  1. The Word - Displayed in large block letters in the center
  2. Progress - Shows “Word X/30” in the header
  3. WPM Bar - Live words-per-minute displayed at the bottom

How to Play

  1. Type the letters you see
  2. Letters turn green when correct, red when wrong
  3. Press Space when you’ve typed the whole word
  4. Complete 30 words to finish the round
  5. View your statistics on the results screen

Keyboard Shortcuts

Key Action
Space Advance to next word
Backspace Delete last character
Ctrl+W Clear entire word
Tab Restart round
Ctrl+O Open options
Esc Exit

item.title: Your First Session
item.description:
Let’s walk through your first complete typing session with Baboon.

Starting the App

Launch Baboon from your terminal:

baboon

You’ll see the typing screen with a word displayed in large block letters.

The Typing Phase

Understanding the Display

  • Header: Shows “BABOON - Typing Practice” and word progress (e.g., “Word 1/30”)
  • Main Area: The current word in large block letters
  • Footer: WPM bar and keyboard hints

Typing Your First Word

  1. Look at the word displayed
  2. Type each letter - watch them turn green as you go
  3. If you make a mistake, the letter turns red
  4. Use Backspace to correct errors
  5. When done, press Space to advance
